ranked_wedges.name: Agent-Ready Commerce Gateway
ranked_wedges.buyer: SMBs, agencies, marketplaces and vertical SaaS companies that want products/services discoverable and purchasable by AI agents
ranked_wedges.monetization: setup fee + monthly platform fee + transaction or catalog-volume fee
ranked_wedges.wedge: Make an existing business machine-readable, trust-readable and transaction-ready without replacing its existing commerce stack.
ranked_wedges.why_now: ACP and UCP are turning agentic discovery and checkout into real distribution channels; merchants need structured product data, trust signals and agent-compatible checkout.

ranked_wedges.name: Commerce Trust and Proof Engine
ranked_wedges.buyer: Enterprise commerce, marketplaces, fintech, procurement and agent platforms
ranked_wedges.monetization: audit fee + per-transaction verification + enterprise license
ranked_wedges.wedge: Independent evidence that separates designed, implemented, verified, deployed and paid states.

ranked_wedges.name: Gauntlet-as-a-Service
ranked_wedges.buyer: Agent platforms, marketplaces, AI SaaS and commerce engineering teams
ranked_wedges.monetization: per-run API pricing + CI subscription + enterprise policy packs
ranked_wedges.wedge: Adversarial acceptance testing for economic actions before an agent is allowed to publish, charge or mutate state.

ranked_wedges.name: Digital Proxy Approval Fabric
ranked_wedges.buyer: Enterprise AI teams deploying agents into high-value workflows
ranked_wedges.wedge: A reusable human-in-the-loop permission boundary between autonomous proposals and consequential actions.

ranked_wedges.name: IP-to-Offer Compiler
ranked_wedges.buyer: Consultancies, studios, software companies and IP-heavy operators
ranked_wedges.wedge: Turn a messy capability/IP inventory into standardized, testable, priced economic objects without exposing private material.

ranked_wedges.name: Silo-Controlled Multi-Vertical Commerce Kernel
ranked_wedges.buyer: Multi-brand operators and marketplaces with sensitive or unrelated business lines
ranked_wedges.wedge: One commerce kernel with hard separation between domains, brands, catalogs and permissions.

ranked_wedges.name: Dreamiez Daily-Streak Economy
ranked_wedges.buyer: Consumer brands, communities and digital-product operators
ranked_wedges.monetization: membership, digital assets, drops, subscriptions and conversion uplift
ranked_wedges.wedge: A persistent identity and reward loop where consistency unlocks scarce digital assets.

ranked_wedges.name: Deterministic Auction and Silo Ticker
ranked_wedges.buyer: Collectibles, specialty goods, creator drops and niche marketplaces
ranked_wedges.monetization: listing fees + transaction take rate + premium auction tools
ranked_wedges.wedge: A reusable auction primitive with proof artifacts and strict catalog separation.

ranked_wedges.name: Enterprise Local-First AI Commerce OS
ranked_wedges.buyer: Organizations that cannot put sensitive commercial operations entirely into third-party SaaS
ranked_wedges.wedge: Local-first economic automation with explicit evidence, approval and deployment boundaries.

ranked_wedges.name: Verticalized Diagnostic Product Factory
ranked_wedges.buyer: Specialist communities and service businesses with expensive expert knowledge
ranked_wedges.monetization: low-ticket diagnostics feeding higher-ticket audits, implementation and subscriptions
ranked_wedges.wedge: Package expert judgment into repeatable digital products, then let the compiler and proof system scale the catalog.

economic_thesis: The strongest moat is not another storefront. It is the trustable economic control plane between agent intent, machine-readable offers, authorization, execution, fulfillment and evidence.
agentic_commerce_position: Build the merchant-side trust and execution layer rather than competing head-on with UCP or ACP. Be protocol-compatible and payment-rail-aware, while owning the verification, policy, provenance and proof layer.
red_team_questions: Can an agent bypass approval and create a chargeable offer?
Can one silo read or mutate another silo's state?
Can public catalog data leak secrets or private IP?
Can a checkout be claimed as a payment without a verified webhook?
Can a future integration be represented as live without an observed endpoint?
Can a duplicate economic object create conflicting price or identity truth?
blue_team_requirements: canonical source for every economic object
